user.title: Connect to FortiGate policies
user.description: Enter one policy ID or a comma-separated list. Every policy is read and identity-checked before this entry is created.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FortiGate policies
reconfigure.description: Enter one policy ID or a comma-separated list. Enter the API token again because its saved value is not shown.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect FortiGate policy
reauth_confirm.description: FortiGate rejected the saved API token. Enter a replacement token.
